messages:
leah: Quick sync — draft release notes below. Need ops + support signoff and a clear canary/rollback runbook before we pin and send internal copy. Can someone take ownership of the support blurb?

samir: I can take support blurb. Will add KB links and the contact matrix.

leah: Thanks. High-level TL;DR I want in the internal snippet: short summary, customer impact (if any), rollback criteria, who to page. Keep it one paragraph for the all-hands blast.

olivia: I can draft the one-paragraph internal announcement. Will drop a draft in a reply in 10m.

kevin: Ops checklist: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or latency p50 > 200ms over window. I'll paste the runbook below.

kevin: ```
Canary plan:
- Stage A (5%): 0-10m monitor metrics (errors, latency, mem)
- Stage B (25%): 10-20m verify business metrics and eval set quality
- Full roll (100%): if no regressions after Stage B
Rollback triggers:
- >= 0.5% user-facing error rate OR
- p50 latency regression > 200ms OR
- Eval set BLEU/QA score drop >= 3 points
Contacts: @samir (support), @kevin (ops), @leah (prod)
```

samir: nit: for rollback triggers, match wording to the runbook KB. I'll link KB in my support blurb. Also suggest adding automatic fallback to model-variant v2.1 if degradation detected.

leah: Good call on model-variant fallback. ops, can the router fallback be enabled during canary?

kevin: Yes, router fallback to v2.1 is ready. We'll set policy to try current model then v2.1 on 500/502s.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: 2026-03-27T16:00:00Z. Canary groups: 5% at start. Canary window length: 30m. Rollout automation enabled.

olivia: Draft internal snippet (first pass):
"Today at 16:00 UTC we’ll deploy model-serving changes (v3.0). No customer-facing changes expected. We will monitor latency and error rates during a staged canary; ops will rollback if thresholds breach. Support: @samir. Full notes + runbook: <link to doc>."

leah: Looks good. Minor phrasing: replace "model-serving changes" with "serving runtime & model update (v3.0)" and add the pinned SHA.

olivia: Updated: "Deploying serving runtime & model update (v3.0, sha: b1f3c9a). No customer-facing changes expected. Canary staged; ops will rollback on threshold breaches. Support: @samir. Full notes + runbook: <link>."

samir: LGTM :thumbsup: I'll add support KB links and on-call escalation steps.

kevin: Ops LGTM. One ask: include a short line in the internal note that alerts partners/sales if they see increased latencies — point them to the status page and support channel.

olivia: Added line about status page and the partners ping. Ready to send once we confirm final anchor link for the runbook.

leah: Final action items: @samir add KB and escalation steps (due in 20m); @kevin confirm router fallback policy is toggled (done); @olivia finalize internal snippet and schedule post to #internal-announces at T+5min of deploy; I'll do the final pin.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% traffic redirected to v3.0 at 2026-03-27T16:00:05Z. Monitoring hooks active.

samir: Support blurb and KB links posted here: <link-to-kb>. Escalation runbook added.

kevin: Observing metrics — initial p50 latency +8ms, error-rate 0.03% (stable). Continuing observation.

olivia: Internal announcement posted to #internal-announces: "Deploy started (v3.0). See runbook: <link>."

leah: Thanks all. If green at 16:35 we'll proceed to 25%. I'll update this thread and pin the final RN SHA for records.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 25% at 2026-03-27T16:35:20Z. No automated rollback triggered.

kevin: Metrics look stable. Advancing to 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% started at 2026-03-27T16:45:10Z. Rollout complete at 2026-03-27T16:50:01Z. No incidents.

leah: Final note: pinned release sha b1f3c9a. Internal announcement sent. Closing thread. :tada:
